name: Financial Statement
description: Canonical line items from XBRL results; the base every fundamentals engine reads

name: Profitability Inflection
description: Losses narrowing with margins and revenue rising

name: Earnings Acceleration
description: EPS growth rate itself accelerating over consecutive quarters

name: Margin Inflection
description: Gross and operating margin turning after a sustained decline

name: Operating Leverage
description: Profit growing faster than revenue because fixed costs are absorbed

name: ROCE / ROIC Inflection
description: Return on capital improving from a trough

name: Cash-Flow Inflection
description: Operating and free cash flow turning positive and converging with profit

name: Debt & Deleveraging
description: Net debt falling quickly against EBITDA and equity

name: Valuation
description: Multiples against own history and sector; valuation attractiveness score

name: Earnings Expectations / Implied Growth
description: What growth the current price requires versus what the company delivers

name: Undervalued Growth
description: Growth and quality rising with a valuation that has not followed

name: Value Trap Filter
description: Cheap for a reason: deteriorating fundamentals behind a low multiple

name: Deep Value
description: Very low valuation backed by assets or cash

name: SOTP / Hidden Asset
description: Sum of parts and non-core assets worth more than the market price

name: Turnaround
description: Recovery from a multi-year stress period in operations and balance sheet

name: Capacity Utilisation
description: Utilisation rising toward the point where incremental margins step up

name: Order Book
description: Order inflow and book-to-bill for project companies

name: Promoter Activity
description: Promoter buying
column9: selling and pledge changes quarter on quarter

name: Institutional Accumulation
description: Foreign and domestic institutions raising their stake quarter on quarter

name: Smart Money / Price Divergence
description: Institutions accumulating while the price has not moved

name: Technical / Price
description: Trend and base structure from raw prices: moving averages and breakouts

name: Relative Strength
description: Return versus the universe over 6 and 12 months

name: Volume & Delivery
description: Volume expansion with rising delivery percentage

name: Sector Rotation
description: Which sectors are gaining relative strength

name: Market Regime
description: Breadth and trend of the market as a whole

name: Corporate Event
description: Buybacks and dividends and demergers and other announced actions

name: Historical Update / Company Timeline
description: What the company said and did and when

name: Management Commentary
description: Guidance and tone extracted from calls and presentations

name: Narrative vs Numbers
description: Where management claims and reported figures disagree

name: Accounting Quality
description: Accruals and cash conversion and related-party and audit flags

name: Corporate Governance
description: Board and audit and related-party and promoter-conduct flags

name: IPO / Newly Listed
description: Recently listed companies through lock-in expiry and first results

name: Catalyst
description: Dated events that can re-rate the stock

name: Underpriced Stock Discovery
description: The opportunity buckets built from the other engines' scores

name: Historical Winner Pattern
description: Nearest neighbours to pre-rerating snapshots of past winners

name: Operating KPI
description: Sector operating metrics extracted from presentations

name: Consensus and Results Reaction
description: Estimate revisions and the price reaction to results

name: Forensic Score Pack
description: Beneish and Altman style scores and their trend

name: Capital Allocation
description: Returns on reinvested capital and acquisitions and buybacks

name: Cyclical and Commodity Linkage
description: Earnings sensitivity to the commodity cycle

name: High-Frequency and Alternative Data
description: Monthly and weekly indicators ahead of results

name: Relationship Graph and Read-Through
description: Customer and supplier and peer read-through

name: Policy and Regulation and Theme
description: Policy changes mapped to the companies they touch

name: Insider and Deal Flow
description: Net buying by named counterparties in bulk and block deals

name: Supply Overhang and Forced Flow
description: Lock-in expiries and pledge sales and index exits that force supply

name: Special Situations
description: Demergers and delistings and open offers

name: Credit Rating Actions
description: Agency downgrades and negative outlooks disclosed to the exchange; upgrades as a mild positiveInterest cover and refinancing stress and rating actions

name: Investability and Liquidity Filter
description: Hard exclusions and liquidity floor applied before any opportunity is shown

name: Scam and Manipulation Detector
description: Price and volume and ownership patterns that look like operator activity

name: Derivatives Signal
description: Open interest and futures basis for the F&O names

name: Document Diff and Language Change
description: Risk-factor and auditor language that changed between filings

name: Unit Economics and Cash Runway
description: Contribution margin and months of cash for loss-making companies

name: Macro and Earnings Sensitivity
description: Earnings beta to rates and currency and oil

name: Company Stance
description: The deterministic summary of every engine's signals for one company

name: Global Resilience
description: Quality names holding up while the world's indexes fall; the mirror is high-beta names falling with shrinking profit

name: Historical P/E
description: Today's P/E against the company's own P/E at past stress troughs and expansion peaks
